name: plugin.earth_engine_spatial_analytics
description: Google Earth Engine vector spatial analytics, zonal reducers, terrain modeling (slope, aspect, hillshade), and dataset catalog governance

entrypoints.name: ee_zonal_statistics
entrypoints.description: Compute spatial statistics (mean, sum, min, max, stdDev, count, histogram) over raster bands within vector polygon regions

parameters.name: image_id
parameters.description: Earth Engine image asset ID or computed raster identifier

parameters.name: geometry_geojson
parameters.description: GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon defining the analysis boundary

parameters.name: reducer
parameters.description: Spatial reduction operation: 'mean', 'sum', 'min', 'max', 'stdDev', 'median', 'count', or 'histogram'

parameters.name: scale_meters
parameters.description: Nominal pixel scale in meters for reduction evaluation

parameters.name: bands
parameters.description: Optional list of band names to reduce (default all bands)

entrypoints.name: ee_analyze_terrain
entrypoints.description: Extract terrain metrics including elevation profile, slope, aspect, and hillshade from digital elevation models

parameters.name: dem_asset
parameters.description: Digital Elevation Model asset ID (e.g. 'USGS/3DEP/10m', 'NASA/NASADEM_HGT/001', 'COPERNICUS/DEM/GLO30')

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Bounding box coordinates as [min_lon, min_lat, max_lon, max_lat]

parameters.name: compute_slope
parameters.description: Whether to calculate terrain slope in degrees

parameters.name: compute_aspect
parameters.description: Whether to calculate terrain aspect in degrees from north

parameters.name: compute_hillshade
parameters.description: Whether to calculate shaded relief illumination

entrypoints.name: ee_vector_spatial_query
entrypoints.description: Query and filter vector FeatureCollections (administrative boundaries, watersheds, parcels) with attribute and geometry filters

parameters.name: table_asset
parameters.description: Earth Engine vector table asset ID (e.g. 'USDOS/LSIB_SIMPLE/2017', 'USGS/WBD/2017/HUC08', 'TIGER/2018/States')

parameters.name: filter_property
parameters.description: Feature attribute property name to filter on

parameters.name: filter_value
parameters.description: Property value match string

parameters.name: geometry_filter
parameters.description: Optional GeoJSON geometry to filter features intersecting boundary

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of vector features to return

entrypoints.name: ee_query_data_catalog
entrypoints.description: Search and discover datasets in the public Earth Engine Data Catalog by keyword, environmental theme, and tag

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free text query string (e.g. 'temperature', 'precipitation', 'elevation', 'landcover')

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Dataset category filter: 'climate', 'weather', 'imagery', 'elevation', 'landcover', or 'oceans'

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Optional keyword tag filters

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of catalog datasets to return

entrypoints.name: ee_manage_batch_task
entrypoints.description: Inspect status, list, monitor, or cancel asynchronous Earth Engine export/import batch jobs

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Task management action: 'list', 'status', or 'cancel'

parameters.name: task_id
parameters.description: Specific task ID when querying status or cancelling

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of tasks to list
